pure-announcement.rationale: Two product launches are embedded, but the piece is a reference architecture write-up grounded in the company's own deployment.

duplicate.rationale: No MCP-governance concept exists in this corpus.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The architecture is described concretely and its OWASP-cited risk rationale is linked.

durability.rationale: The patterns — remote-first MCP servers as a supply-chain control, governance baked into a template platform (default-deny writes, audit, CI/CD, secrets for free), and gateway-level shadow-MCP detection — survive the product names they are demonstrated on.

actionability.rationale: A reference architecture with the deployment sequence and controls named; portable to other stacks at the architecture level.

atomicity.rationale: Bundles at least four separable ideas: remote-first MCP governance, the governed template platform, Code Mode's token economics, and shadow-MCP detection.
